dev-deepawali.note: Kartik Purnima. Drik Panchang (Varanasi) lists Dev Diwali on Tue 24 Nov 2026; Purnima runs until 8:23 PM that day, so the pradosh deepdan falls on the 24th. The UP Government 2026 holiday list gives Kartik Purnima (with Guru Nanak Jayanti) on 24 Nov, and the Varanasi divisional administration's preparatory meeting (Aug 2026, see Ganga Mahotsav sources) also names 24 Nov.

ganga-mahotsav.note: No official 2026 dates yet. A preparatory meeting in Aug 2026 discussed 20–23 Nov (Rajghat, with Dev Deepawali on 24 Nov), reported only by local outlets; UP Tourism had not announced dates as of 25 Sep 2026. Re-check uptourism.gov.in nearer the date.

ramnagar-ramlila.note: Begins on Anant Chaturdashi, Fri 25 Sep 2026 (confirmed by local report and the UP holiday list). The end date is computed, not announced: 31 days reaches Ashwin (Sharad) Purnima, which Drik Panchang puts on Sun 25 Oct 2026 (Purnima 11:55 AM on 25 Oct to 9:41 AM on 26 Oct). Some sites give 26 Oct for Sharad Purnima.

ganga-dussehra.note: Jyeshtha Shukla Dashami (in the adhik Jyeshtha of 2026). Varanasi observed it on Tue 26 May: Amar Ujala's Varanasi desk reported the main ghat snan (about 3 lakh devotees) that day, following udaya tithi as announced by the Kashi Vishwanath Nyas. Drik Panchang and Aaj Tak list 25 May, when the Dashami tithi began (4:30 AM).

parshvanath-janma-kalyanak.note: No Purnimanta Paush Krishna Dashami (Jain 'Posh Dashmi', i.e. Gujarati Magshar Vad 10) falls in calendar 2026. The previous one was about 14 Dec 2025 and the next about 1-2 Jan 2027 (Kartik Purnima is 24 Nov 2026, so Margashirsha Purnima is around 23-24 Dec 2026). By Amanta month naming, 'Paush Krishna Dashami' is 12 Jan 2026 (Drik Panchang Krishna Dashami list), but Jain temples do not use that date for Posh Dashmi. Confirm with Shri Parshvanath Digambar/Shvetambar temples, Bhelupur.

eid-al-fitr.note: 1 Shawwal 1447 AH. The Shawwal crescent was sighted in India on 20 Mar and Eid was celebrated on Sat 21 Mar 2026, matching the DoPT and UP holiday lists. Saudi Arabia and the UAE marked it a day earlier, on 20 Mar.

kashi-tamil-sangamam-festival.note: No 2026 edition (KTS 5.0) has been announced as of 25 Sep 2026. The latest edition, KTS 4.0 ('Tamil Karkalam'), was inaugurated in Varanasi on 2 Dec 2025 and ran until mid-Dec 2025. One travel blog lists 'KTS 5.0: 2-15 Dec 2026', which appears to copy the 2025 dates; no official source confirms it.
